# Official PHP images used to *seed* the offline rootfs tarballs.
# Runtime docker builds do not pull these; they ADD vendor/rootfs/*.tar.gz.
#
# php:8.3.33-cli-alpine
#   linux/amd64 sha256:6443da203cc731224936b7e842971f0067a596d60839144650ca5c11a2f3c98f
#   linux/arm64 sha256:989d2bdaa98bcebcecd07604a1afd9c6659d4b874ab874b75e849a622399c872
#
# php:7.4.33-cli-alpine
#   linux/amd64 sha256:1e1b3bb4ee1bcb039f559adb9a3fae391c87205ba239b619cdc239b78b7f2557
#   linux/arm64 sha256:dbce323a8fd856cbd383920374bf9815c2f6503746ceb12e86ca3ec07545160a
#
# PHP 5.6 is not vendored (no evalhook). Dockerfile.5.6 still pulls php:5.6-cli.
